hypothesis: Replacing the always-first conditioning field with the immediately preceding completed field exposes a distinct causal association on a separating fixture while preserving exact deterministic codec reconstruction. Corpus occurrence, gain and package viability remain untested.
changed_mechanism: One conditioning coordinate: (template, previous_key, previous_value, target_key); commit adjacent completed pairs only at valid invocation closure. No fallback or selection search.
deliverables: Exact retained synthetic archives, independent inverses, repeat hashes, full probability and state comparison evidence, and source inventory.
preserved: FIFO128 table and 256-byte WRT donor cap
Compatible WRT entry states and aligned completed spans
Existing integer ParentMixture and native-reference arithmetic semantics
All sealed source bindings, HORIZON recovery ownership, MIDAS components and confirmation data

controls.P: Unchanged synthetic constant Q16=32768 parent; no selector injection.
controls.K: Adjacent table/bookkeeping but zero probability injection; probabilities and payload must match P.
controls.O: Original first-field selector, retained unchanged as comparator.
controls.R: Most recent same-template/target-field compatible donor from the corresponding adjacent table.
controls.S: Rotated association from the corresponding adjacent table, only when exact association and alternatives exist.

required_checks: Before the third v value, T chooses the first donor, R and S choose the second, and O abstains.
Changing only the undecoded third value preserves preceding predictions and all state.
Two-field invocations reproduce original selection behavior modulo explicit policy identity.
Malformed, incomplete and invalidated invocations do not commit associations; bounds, FIFO eviction, incompatible states and unaligned spans remain enforced.
Each arm independently decodes, reconstructs exact raw bytes, repeats the archive and synchronizes complete adapter/mixture/coder state and probabilities. Matching size alone is insufficient.
Report whole framed archives under identical synthetic Q16 and frame policy, plus separate dependency/source inventory; do not infer enwik9 compression.
stopping_conditions: Stop the test invocation on any bound, source identity mismatch, state or inverse failure; preserve failed attempts.
Do not inspect corpus or launch a corpus gate. A separately frozen prospective experiment and published ownership are required after synthetic review.
Do not tune multiple selectors, add a mixture, expand the parser, or build another architecture.
package_estimate: No model assets; required local source closure plus interpreter/runtime remain separately counted and incomplete. New selector module is capped at 16384 raw source bytes, not a complete package score.
